entities.summary: Chiraz Latiri Cherif is a Tunisian academic, cultural researcher and politician. In 2006, she joined the staff of Manouba University where she specialized in cinema and multimedia. After heading the Tunisian Cinema and Image Centre (2017–2019), in February 2020 she was appointed Minister of Culture. That month, the Arab Cinema Center and The Hollywood Reporter honoured Latiri with the Arab Cinema Personality of The Year award.
